Name: CHECK DESCRIPTION The Bearded Doctor - Harvey Portrait Mod
Author: fibso
Description:
[size=4]I like beards, [b]however[/b], [/size][size=4]mustaches look good on very few people. Harvey isn't one of them.[/size]

[b][size=1]Harvey's dorky and cute personality is what inspired me to make this... along with my love for beards. Nice beard AND a dork? 10/10 combo. I originally started this for just myself. Clearly.

During the first day of working on this, I made a silly mistake. Decided to post the oopsie on the SDV mods subreddit, and the amount of people into my Harvey design made me decide to share it on here.[/size][/b]

[size=2][b][i]Plans for the future of this mod[/i][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=1]To get better at ConcernedApe's art style because while I like my Harvey style (thanks to your kind words!), I'm a tad less happy about the sprite I made. I personally think it's fine for a first mod[/size][/*]
[*][size=1][s]Finish up Harvey's winter outfit  [/s]✔️[/size][/*]
[*][size=1]Change his house/clinic style. I'm working on a different architecture design of buildings/houses and have thought about changing some of the interiors.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[b]If you have any questions, encounter any issues, or anything else, I'm here to help. I'm still navigating how the mod author thing works, so not while helping you, you're also helping me learn![/b]

[b]Navigating how to write the content file was daunting at first because it's my first mod.[/b]
[b]I'm super appreciative of [/b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Pathoschild?gameId=1303]Pathoschild[/url][b]﻿. I wouldn't have been able to do this without their [/b][url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/develop/ContentPatcher/docs/author-guide]content patcher author guide[/url][b]![/b]
